title: Hooked on Travel
description:
S01 E19 — The Skeleton Coast
This stretch of coastline has claimed more ships and spun more stories of sunken treasure than any in Africa, justifying its title. The team venture along this barren landscape unearthing species unique to this rich coastline despite the inclement...

title: Reel Africa
description:
S02 E06 — Royal Flush
The Royal Flush a hand that can't be beaten! Kings and Queens abound in Mozambique's waters off Beira, a light tackle angler's paradise.

title: Inside Angling
description:
S01 E08 — The Bone Collector
Alphonse Island is one of the world's most pristine fly-fishing destinations. While out chasing Billfish in the surrounding blue waters, we decided to head to the flats and try our luck with the world-famous Bonefish.

title: Wildfly Best of
description:
S02 E19 — The Great Rift
Home of the notorious Goliath Tiger and Monster Perch, it's a destination that few have ventured to. We explore the crystal-clear tropical waters of this spectacular body of fresh water, hunting its endemic species.

description:

Denis Isbister and Austin Lindsey travel to remote Yakutat, Alaska, and put the hammer down on giant steelhead.

description:
